name: Cirno's Perfect Summer Vacation
source: When Cirno discovers a magical item in Gensokyo, her power grows as she freezes all the land! Not satisfied with just Gensokyo, she opens a portal to try and freeze New York in the summer! A free short Touhou adventure made for the Touhou 9 Jam.
translation: 当琪露诺在幻想乡发现一件魔法物品时，她的力量随着她冻结所有土地而增强！她不满足于幻想乡，她打开了一个传送门，试图让夏天的纽约变得冰冻！专为东方9 Jam制作的免费东方短篇冒险游戏。
